title: Coverings of a w-contractible affine are refined by clopen partitions
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let $U=\operatorname{Spec}D$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with $D$ w-contractible [det-pe-wlocal-strict-contractible] be an object of $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ [sk-def-pe-site], and let $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ be a covering in this site. There are a finite partition $U=U'_1\sqcup\dots\sqcup U'_m$ into clopen subschemes (open subschemes [def-weil-open-immersion] whose underlying subsets are closed), indices $i_1,\dots,i_m$, and $U$-morphisms $g_k\colon U'_k\to U_{i_k}$. The empty partition is allowed when $U$ is empty.

proof.text: Map the covering presieve to schemes using ProEt.mem_precoverage_iff and Presieve.map_ofArrows. The quasi-compact half gives QuasiCompactCover for the original family, without shrinking its arbitrary-universe indexing type. Apply QuasiCompactCover.exists_isAffineOpen_of_isCompact to the entire affine target to obtain Fin n, selected indices b, affine opens U k and the equality of the union of their images with the target. The weakly etale half gives weak etaleness of each selected covering arrow.

Set Y k = (U k).toScheme and p k equal to its inclusion followed by the selected covering arrow. Form the finite coproduct of the Y k. It is affine. Mathlib open-immersion and composition instances give WeaklyEtale (p k), and IsZariskiLocalAtSource.sigmaDesc gives WeaklyEtale (Sigma.desc p). The image equality from step 1, after identifying each image with the range of p k, gives surjectivity by Surjective.sigmaDesc_of_union_range_eq_univ. These are exactly the finite-affine-cover consequences of the site definition.

Use AlgebraicGeometry.exists_comp_eq_id_of_isWContractibleRing from WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.WeaklyContractible, the already proved scheme-level implementation of det-pe-wcb-split-cover, to obtain s with s ≫ Sigma.desc p = identity. Its implementation identifies the affine source with its spectrum, converts weak etaleness and surjectivity into a faithfully flat weakly etale ring map, refines to an ind-etale algebra and applies IsWContractibleRing.exists_retraction. Thus it follows the required unit split-cover route and avoids importing the separate bundled comparison and stability theorems.

Let O k be the inverse image under s of the open range of the kth coprojection. The sigma open cover shows that these opens cover; disjoint_opensRange_sigmaι shows that they are pairwise disjoint. For each k, the complement of O k is the union of O j over j ≠ k: covering proves one containment and disjointness the other. It is open, so O k is closed. This works also for empty source and empty indexing type.

The range of (O k).ι ≫ s lies in the kth component. IsOpenImmersion.lift therefore gives t k into Y k. The lift equation, Sigma.ι_desc and the section equation give t k ≫ p k = (O k).ι. Restrict the finite indexing type to K = {k // (O k).Nonempty}, and use (Finite.equivFin K).symm to index it by Fin (Nat.card K). Disjointness follows from injectivity, and covering follows by choosing the original piece containing each point, which is necessarily nonempty. Compose t with the selected open inclusion to obtain the desired maps to the original covering members. Associativity proves their required equation. If the target is empty, K is empty and Nat.card K = 0.

lean.statement: theorem proetale_wContractible_clopen_partition (X : Scheme.{u}) (D : Type u) [CommRing D] [IsWContractibleRing D] (f : Spec (.of D) ⟶ X) [WeaklyEtale f] (I : Type v) (V : I → X.ProEt) (a : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶ ProEt.mk f) (hcover : Presieve.ofArrows V a ∈ ProEt.precoverage X (ProEt.mk f)) : ∃ (m : ℕ) (W : Fin m → (Spec (.of D)).Opens), (∀ k : Fin m, IsClosed (W k : Set (Spec (.of D)))) ∧ (∀ k : Fin m, (W k : Set (Spec (.of D))).Nonempty) ∧ Pairwise (fun j k : Fin m ↦ Disjoint (W j) (W k)) ∧ iSup W = ⊤ ∧ ∃ (i : Fin m → I) (g : ∀ k : Fin m, (W k).toScheme ⟶ (V (i k)).left), ∀ k : Fin m, g k ≫ (a (i k)).left = (W k).ι
